summary: Peoples Bancorp filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) on September 28, 2026, disclosing receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals for its merger with Citizens National Corporation (OTC: CZNL), with Peoples as surviving corporation, and for the related bank merger with Citizens Bank of Kentucky into Peoples Bank. The Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated April 20, 2026, was approved by Citizens shareholders on August 6, 2026. No price, exchange ratio, premium, or advisor is disclosed. Mechanics are standard two-step bank holding company consolidation; closing and integration timing now the key watch items.
